summary: Delta Force entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Delta Force

primary.why: The original Delta Force is a NovaLogic PC tactical shooter. The current PC storefront route is the practical way to capture the campaign, while original online NovaWorld-era multiplayer state should be treated as historical unless a current server route is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows PC release. Record storefront, patch/build, OS compatibility, resolution, controls, campaign mission, difficulty, voxel/render settings, multiplayer/server state if sampled, and distinguish it from the newer Delta Force reboot.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving original install/patch/multiplayer history.
secondary.why: Current PC release is the practical capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record build and multiplayer/server state; title is the 1998 NovaLogic game.
